        ORG     25000
        LD      HL,#5CF4
        LD      (HL),#7
        INC     HL
        LD      (HL),#11
        LD      HL,26000
        LD      (START),HL
        LD      A,27
        LD      (LEN),A
        LD      A,(#5D16)
        RES     4,A
        LD      (DRIVE+1),A
        JR      STRT

PRINT   EQU     16384
START   DW      0
LEN     DB      0
NAD1    DB      0
NAD2    DB      0
NAD3    DB      0
NAD4    DB      10
BACK    DB      255

STRT    EI
        HALT
        SUB     A
        LD      C,A
        LD      D,A
        LD      E,A
        LD      A,(LEN)
        LD      B,3
L1      SUB     100
        JR      C,DES
        INC     C
        DJNZ    L1
DES     ADD     A,100
        LD      B,10
L2      SUB     10
        JR      C,ED
        INC     E
        DJNZ    L2
ED      ADD     A,10
        OR      A
        JR      Z,END
        INC     D
        LD      B,10
L3      DEC     A
        JR      Z,END
        INC     D
        DJNZ    L3
END     LD      IX,NAD1
        LD      A,C
        LD      (NAD1),A
        LD      (NAD2),DE
        LD      DE,PRINT
LOOP    LD      A,(IX)
        LD      L,A
        CP      255
        JR      Z,VER
        PUSH    DE
        SUB     A
        LD      H,A
        ADD     HL,HL
        ADD     HL,HL
        ADD     HL,HL
        LD      BC,NUMB
        ADD     HL,BC
        LD      B,8
LOOP1   LD      A,(HL)
        LD      (DE),A
        INC     D
        INC     HL
        DJNZ    LOOP1
        POP     DE
        INC     E
        INC     IX
        JR      LOOP
VER     LD      A,(NAD4)
        CP      10
        JR      NZ,YUI
        LD      A,11
BBC     LD      (NAD4),A
        JR      LOA
YUI     LD      A,10
        JR      BBC
LOA     LD      A,(LEN)
        OR      A
        JP      Z,L_OK
        DI
        SUB     A
        INC     A
        LD      B,A
        LD      HL,(START)
        LD      DE,(#5CF4)
M1      PUSH    BC
        LD      C,D
        SRL     C
DRIVE   LD      A,#2C
        JR      C,M2
        ADD     A,#10
M2      LD      IX,#1FF3
        CALL    DOS
        LD      A,C
        LD      C,#7F
        LD      IX,#2A53
        CALL    DOS
        LD      A,#18
        LD      IX,#2FC3
        CALL    DOS
        POP     BC
M3      PUSH    DE,BC
        LD      IX,#2F1B
        CALL    DOS
        POP     BC,DE
        INC     E
        INC     H
        BIT     4,E
        JR      NZ,M4
        DJNZ    M3
        JR      LOE
M4      INC     D
        LD      E,0
        DJNZ    M1
LOE     LD      (#5CF4),DE
        LD      A,(LEN)
        DEC     A
        LD      (LEN),A
        LD      HL,(START)
        LD      DE,256
        ADD     HL,DE
        LD      (START),HL
        JP      STRT
NUMB    DB 0,0,254,206,214,230,254,0,0,0,248,56,56,56,254,0,0,0
        DB 254,6,254,224,254,0,0,0,254,6,254,6,254,0,0,0,230,230
        DB 254,6,6,0,0,0,254,224,254,6,254,0,224,224,224,224,254
        DB 230,254,0,0,0,254,6,6,6,6,6,0,0,254,230,254,230,254,0
        DB 0,0,254,230,254,6,6,6,0,0,0,0,0,0,255,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0
        DB 0
FONE    DB #30,0,1,0,#50,0,0,#38,#10,#10,#10,#C4,#50,1,#C8
PAUSE   LD      B,15
PA_1    EI
        HALT
        DJNZ    PA_1
        RET
DOS     PUSH    IX
        JP      #3D2F
L_OK    LD      HL,FONE
        SUB     A
ZW3     LD      BC,#FFFD
        OUT     (C),A
        PUSH    AF
        LD      A,(HL)
        LD      BC,#BFFD
        OUT     (C),A
        INC     HL
        POP     AF
        INC     A
        CP      #F
        JR      NZ,ZW3
        LD      B,5
L_OB    PUSH    BC
        LD      HL,PRINT+3+(256*6)
        LD      (HL),255
        CALL    PAUSE
        LD      (HL),0
        CALL    PAUSE
        POP     BC
        DJNZ    L_OB
        EI
        RET
